text:
mira: incoming ticket T-4921 — user reports free trial blocked by fraud checks. customer email devco@testmail.xyz, IP 45.33.12.101 (resolved to US), billing country NL. customer claims remote contractor in NL. flags: vpn_detected, disposable_email, geo_mismatch. attaching quick log snippet.

```json
{
  \"ticket\": \"T-4921\",
  \"email\": \"devco@testmail.xyz\",
  \"ip\": \"45.33.12.101\",
  \"ip_country\": \"US\",
  \"billing_country\": \"NL\",
  \"flags\": [\"vpn_detected\", \"disposable_email\", \"geo_mismatch\"]
}
```

fraud-bot: automated risk_score=87 — requires manual review :rotating_light:

samir: can someone pull the auth headers and device fingerprint? need X-Forwarded-For, user-agent, any payment attempts, and last 4 of client IP from logs. also want ASN lookup for 45.33.12.101.

Suggested quick checks:
```bash
# search support logs for ticket and recent auth attempts
rg \"T-4921\" /var/log/support/*.log
# auth db query (internal)
select * from auth_logs where ticket = 'T-4921' limit 50;
```

olivia: no payment attempted. promo applied = TRIAL50. no CC on file. could consider a limited manual credit if risk team ok.

jordan: recommend 24h hold + request KYC (corporate email or ID). @samir can you check ASN/provider for 45.33.12.101 — if it's cloud/hosting it's high risk. if residential NL provider and UA matches browser + timezone, lower risk.

samir: quick ASN check shows AS14061 (DigitalOcean) — ephemeral cloud ip. email domain testmail.xyz hits our disposable list. both increase fraud probability.

mira: customer replied: they say they use ProtonVPN while traveling; attached screenshot of NL bank transfer confirmation but refuse to share ID. asking for immediate override to unblock trial (small usage).

olivia: propose partial/manual grant: 1k tokens credit for 7 days while we hold promo redemption. minimizes exposure.

jordan: +1 conditional: give limited credit only if they add corporate email or we observe consistent NL IPs for 48h. if they fail, revoke credit and mark account for fraud. set promo hold/escrow. :white_check_mark:

samir: agreed. I'll flag account for manual review and add escalations note. leaving fraud_score and DX logs intact.

mira: OK — will reply to customer with conditional offer, request corporate email or 48h NL usage trace. tagging ops to place promo in escrow and prevent billing until verification. closing here, will update ticket T-4921 when done. :lock:
